This modules provides a simplified access to a dsp402 enabled device.

= Configuration =

 - name: my_dsp402
   so_file: libmodule_dsp402.so
   config: 
     devices:
       - name: wheel_left
         pdin: ecat.slave_1.inputs.pd
         pdout: ecat.slave_1.outputs.pd
         status_word_name: statusword
         control_word_name: controlword
         status_word_offset: 0
         control_word_offset: 0
   power_up: op

; name
: This field should be a unique name. The new process data devices will be registered with names like '''my_dsp402.wheel_left.inputs.pd'''.
; pdin
: Specifies an existing process data device where the inputs will be read.
; pdout
: Specifies an existing process data device where the outputs will be written.
; status_word_name
: The name of the status word field in the process data description of ''pdin''.
; control_word_name
: The name of the control word field in the process data description of ''pdout''.
; status_word_offset
: Optionally a user may supply a status word offset in ''pdin''. This maybe usefull, if there's not process data description available. 
; control_word_offset
: Optionally a user may supply a control word offset in ''pdout''. This maybe usefull, if there's not process data description available.
